reconstruction.scope: Specific standing Dashavatara Temple at Deogarh: reddish sandstone square sanctuary, true recessed carved west doorway, three original simplified framed relief compositions, nested jambs/lintels, moulded cornices/miniature-aedicule/scroll rhythm and irregular broken surviving upper masonry. Raised occupied square plinth with moulded edges, approximate four centered stair approaches/cheeks and low corner footing remnants. No complete shikhara restoration, copied deity/story/text atlas or full ritual interior. Existing shared stone graphs, metric UVs/linear tints and four browser levels.
